name: A Threat Within

meta.next: Kobold Camp Cleanup, Eagan Peltskinner (quest), Brotherhood of Thieves

summary: Volunteers are answering Stormwind's call in Northshire Valley, where local defenses need help. At Northshire Abbey, Marshal McBride explains that the kingdom's forces are spread thin abroad, leaving garrisons short-handed against trouble at home.

sections.title: A Kingdom Stretched Thin
sections.body: Northshire Valley once offered quiet for prayer, farming, and monastic study. Now it is Elwynn Forest's first line of defense against unrest at home. Stormwind's regular forces serve on distant fronts, leaving the heartlands short of soldiers. With few guards nearby, the Stormwind Guard must call on every willing volunteer who reaches the abbey.

sections.title: The Marshal's Call
sections.body: Marshal McBride directs Northshire Valley's defenses from Northshire Abbey as pressures grow. Distant dangers threaten the Alliance, while bandits, vermin, and pests from below ground take advantage of the shortage of soldiers close to home. You answer the call to serve in the valley, starting with the ground around the abbey as threats spread across Elwynn.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Marshal McBride is calling new arrivals to Northshire Valley to join its defense. You go inside Northshire Abbey and report to him.
Marshal McBride is the senior Stormwind Guard officer at Northshire Abbey. He directs the valley's defense and assigns recruits to address threats in the nearby countryside.

faq.q: Why is Stormwind recruiting volunteers instead of sending regular soldiers?
faq.answer: Stormwind's regular forces are serving abroad to protect the Alliance. With heartland garrisons short of soldiers, local commanders rely on volunteers to defend their homes.

faq.q: What threats are currently plaguing Northshire Valley?
faq.answer: Kobolds infest the nearby mines and hills, while diseased or predatory pests trouble the vineyards. Brigands and outlaws also take advantage of the valley's depleted garrison.

faq.q: Where does this assignment lead next?
faq.answer: After you report to Marshal McBride, you are sent to clear kobolds from the hills, help local farmers and workers, and look into the growing presence of organized bandits.

faq.q: Why is Northshire Abbey being used as a military command post?
faq.answer: Northshire Abbey is a holy place of study and faith, but its stone walls and central position make it the valley's practical base. With local authority under strain, the Stormwind Guard has set up its command within the abbey.

angles.text: As a human defender from Northshire, answering Marshal McBride's call is your first official pledge to protect your homeland and the Kingdom of Stormwind.
As an Alliance member, you see how commitments across distant lands leave even its heartlands exposed to trouble within.
